name: Abominable Magics
summary: Apprentice Claire asks you to gather samples of Twilight's Hammer magic in a cave beneath Sunnyglade. Farholde needs the samples so she can study the cult's witchcraft.

sections.title: Claire's Request
sections.body: Claire sent by Ashe Amberhall investigates Twilight's Hammer in the Riverglades, where cultists dig for something. She needs a sample of their witchcraft to understand it. You carry a Crystal Catalyst enchanted to absorb the cult's power from runes or cultists, and Claire says Farholde urgently needs what it gathers.

sections.title: A Potent Sample
sections.body: When you return, Claire touches the crystal and flinches at the magic crackling within it. The gathered power is stronger than she feared, and she says it must be handled with care.

faq.q: Who is asking for the samples?
faq.answer: Apprentice Claire asks you to gather samples of Twilight's Hammer magic for her.

faq.q: Why does Claire need the samples?
faq.answer: Claire wants to study the cult's witchcraft, and she says Farholde urgently needs the samples.
Twilight's Hammer is digging for something within the Riverglades.

faq.q: What does the Crystal Catalyst do?
faq.answer: The enchanted Crystal Catalyst absorbs the power of Twilight's Hammer magic from runes or cultists.
Ashe Amberhall sent Claire to investigate Twilight's Hammer.
